visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand reaches into the frame holding a small brown kibble treat toward a tortoiseshell cat with green eyes in a bright room. The scene cuts to a white and grey cat eating the treat from the hand. The floor is light-colored wood. (2) A calico cat is shown from above eating wet food from a white ceramic plate placed on a light wood floor. In the background, there is a wooden slat structure and a fish-shaped toy lying on the floor. (3) A small white and black cat lies on its side on a wooden floor, playfully moving its front paws. The lighting is bright and even. Then a tabby kitten sits upright and bats at a white balloon hanging from a string. (4) A black kitten with white patches on its chest is inside a brown wire cage. It looks toward the camera and opens its mouth as if meowing or panting. The background shows a white wall and a pet bed. (5) A full-screen graphic appears with a beige background. It displays mathematical text in Traditional Chinese and English describing a daily calorie requirement formula for cats, accompanied by a small icon of a cat. (6) Close-up shots of a white and grey cat looking out a window, followed by a tortoiseshell cat resting on a white surface. The hand is then shown operating a smartphone calculator app with a black interface, performing calculations. (7) A hand holds a smartphone on the back of a sleeping ginger and white cat. The calculator screen shows numbers and square root symbols. Later, a ginger cat on a wooden table interacts with a red treat using its paw. (8) A calico cat eats mousse-like food from a bowl surrounded by stacked blue and white cans and packets of 好味小姐 brand cat food. A hand holds up a blue spatula tool against a white background. (9) The video concludes with a large, detailed graphic table titled in Traditional Chinese, summarizing daily calorie requirements across various cat life stages and weights.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 貓咪一天要吃多少呢？ [Logo]: 好味小姐 LADY FLAVOR. (2) [Subtitle]: 貓咪吃太多或吃太少都會對貓咪的身體造成問題. (3) [Subtitle]: 到底一天要吃多少才夠勒？ (4) [Subtitle]: 準確來說我們應該要計算貓咪一天所需要的熱量作為進食量夠不夠的依據. (5) [Subtitle]: 除了體重之外呢還要考慮到貓咪的年紀活動量以及絕育與否才能計算出最符合貓咪需求的熱量哦. (6) [Subtitle]: 簡單說明一下貓咪一日熱量所需的公式讓大家用計算機就可以簡單計算出來. (7) [Slogan]: 貓咪一日熱量需求公式. [Variety]: 每日熱量需求. [Variety]: DER(每日熱量需求)=體重(kg)的0.75次方 x 70 x 需求因子. (8) [Subtitle]: 聽起來有點複雜影片的最後有幫大家貼心直接通通算好讓大家用索引的方式來找到自己的熱量需求表. (9) [Subtitle]: 也歡迎大家直接截圖使用哦！ (10) [Subtitle]: 好接下來打開計算機跟著我們示範一步一步來吧. (11) [Subtitle]: 首先打開手機計算機的左下角有科學模式. (12) [Subtitle]: 以短褲的體重5公斤為例按下兩次開根號鍵再輸入5x5x5. (13) [Subtitle]: 得到短褲一天需要的熱量等於剛剛開根號的這個數值乘上70x1.2等於280.9大卡！ (14) [Subtitle]: 嚴謹的話記得也可以把貓咪們平常吃的零食的熱量也算進去就可以好好掌握貓咪們的日常所需了！ (15) [Subtitle]: 好說到這裡讓我們來小小工商一下. (16) [Subtitle]: 好味1+1鮮魚+慕斯主食罐新上架！ (17) [Subtitle]: 滿足挑嘴貓咪的易舔食慕斯質地好入口好消化貼近貓咪的天性喜好. (18) [Subtitle]: 現在只要訂單內含有1+1鮮魚+慕斯主食罐就會再送你好味貓罐匙一支數量有限大家要趕快去逛逛看看喔. (19) [Subtitle]: 我是好味小姐養貓要知道那你知道了嗎？ (20) [Slogan]: 貓咪每日所需熱量表.
